name: Plant Seedlings Dataset: Crop and Weed Classification Benchmark
description: The Plant Seedlings Dataset is a foundational computer vision benchmark created by Aarhus University and the University of Southern Denmark to advance automated site-specific weed recognition. Recorded at the Aarhus University Flakkebjerg Research Station, the dataset comprises 5,539 RGB images of approximately 960 individual plants belonging to 12 agricultural weed and crop species (Maize, Common wheat, Sugar beet, Scentless Mayweed, Common Chickweed, Shepherd's Purse, Cleavers, Charlock, Fat Hen, Small-flowered Cranesbill, Black-grass, and Loose Silky-bent). Images possess a physical resolution of roughly 10 pixels per millimeter, capturing plants across varied early seedling vegetative growth stages.
